jobs.edit: Rebuild ONLY the book and arms in a TRUE REAR view of OPEN book: two indigo back-cover panels with center spine, NO face on fore-edge. Keep small right-side figure using telescope. LEFT hand holding telescope knob, thin LEFT arm starts BEHIND LEFT OUTERMOST contour at mid-side, never painted on broad back panel. RIGHT hand resting on bookshelf outside right silhouette. Cover occludes both arm roots. Preserve galaxy, telescope and blue frame.

Reconstruct ONLY book and arms. Real OPEN cream book facing three-quarter LEFT, both inner pages and gutter visible, worried effort expression. LEFT hand pushes nearest large scroll at LEFT of body, with thin left arm coming from BEHIND LEFT outer cover silhouette. RIGHT hand extends OUTSIDE RIGHT body to brace on scroll on the right, thin right arm from BEHIND RIGHT cover contour. One arm each side, roots fully hidden by covers. Remove both previous arms from cream page face entirely. Preserve stairway of scrolls, library and gold frame.

Rebuild book and BOTH arms as a proper open book facing camera from slightly above at tilted angle, peaceful proud expression. LEFT hand holds LEFT ribbon loop OUTSIDE LEFT edge of body, RIGHT hand holds RIGHT ribbon loop OUTSIDE RIGHT edge. Both arms thin indigo, emerging from BEHIND corresponding OUTERMOST cover edge, roots hidden. NO arm painted on any cream page or broad cover panel. Keep scroll below with ribbon tying, quill, blue ink, flowers and blue frame.

Reconstruct open book and BOTH arms, preserving diagonal floating pose over card machine. Two cream inner page faces, gutter, indigo rear covers, happy wink, cap/bookmark. LEFT arm extends to LEFT outside body offering palm to flying card; RIGHT arm lifts RIGHT outside body holding a leaf card above-right. Each thin arm originates behind OUTERMOST corresponding SIDE cover contour at mid-height; cover hides root. Delete old rounded socket from face. Preserve mint arrow loop, desk, card machine and bronze frame.

Rebuild ONLY book and arms, real OPEN book at three-quarter view facing down-right, cream inner pages both visible and gentle concentrated face. LEFT hand holds watering can to LEFT of book, RIGHT hand steadies spout to RIGHT of book. Can is in foreground overlapping lower book so proximal forearms naturally occluded behind can and leaves. No rounded blue roots on back-cover or page plane; origins hidden BEHIND outer sides. Preserve growing leaf cards, dew, water and sapphire frame.

Rebuild book and arms in elephant trunk hammock. True OPEN book tilted back like a reclining book, two cream inner page planes with face, central gutter, indigo covers beneath, joyous. LEFT hand holds leaf card high OUTSIDE LEFT cover edge toward elephant, RIGHT hand waves to elephant OUTSIDE RIGHT cover edge. Each narrow indigo arm connects behind its own OUTER SIDE cover at mid-side. Remove old arm that grows from cream face. Preserve elephant, flowers, hammock framing and emerald frame.

Replace malformed nearly closed phone-like book with a real OPEN BOOK reclining diagonally on velvet cushion, both cream inner pages and gutter with sleepy gentle face, indigo covers beneath. Seen close at low three-quarter angle, eyes nearly closed after long study. LEFT hand holds a small closed study booklet OUTSIDE LEFT silhouette; RIGHT hand rests on cushion OUTSIDE RIGHT silhouette. Thin arms from BEHIND corresponding outer SIDE cover edges, roots occluded. No face on book thickness or back, no arms attached to cover plane. Keep sun and moon windows, hourglass and sapphire frame.

Reconstruct book and both arms. True OPEN book at low three-quarter camera angle looking right, two cream inner face pages plus gutter and indigo back covers. LEFT hand presents a glowing red cross OUTSIDE LEFT silhouette; RIGHT hand presents green check OUTSIDE RIGHT silhouette, golden metamorphosis trail between them. Thin connected indigo arms arise BEHIND OUTERMOST cover sides, root never visible on pages or broad cover planes. No floating detached glove. Preserve error sheet on table, lamp/library and bronze frame.

Preserve overhead open book on mint cushion, calm closed eyes and breathing smile, hourglass left, warm desk and bronze frame. REMOVE BOTH old arms and hands that lie on cream pages. New arms REST RELAXED OUTSIDE corresponding LEFT and RIGHT body contours, cream hands gently resting on cushion beside book, not on pages. Thin indigo proximal arms hidden BEHIND outer side hardcover edges. Book lies OPEN with two inner page planes and gutter. Roots must not appear as rounded sockets on cover or page.

Preserve owl perched on cap, lamp, starry night and silver frame. Change arm gesture entirely to remove floating elbows below book. Book tilts slightly right, eyes looking UP toward owl, amused attentive expression. LEFT hand lightly turns foreground reading-book page at LEFT OUTSIDE character; RIGHT hand steadies lamp base at RIGHT OUTSIDE character. Thin indigo arms from BEHIND OUTER SIDE cover edges at mid-height, roots occluded by cover. Do not rest hands on own cheeks. True open book, two cream face pages and gutter, no legs.

There are THREE hands! REMOVE ENTIRE NEAR ARM and cream hand gripping trophy from front, specifically the blue arm from x560,y675 across lower face to cream hand x730,y625. Repaint clean cream paper/page edges and trophy stem beneath it. Keep exactly TWO hands: LEFT hand holds check card at far left, RIGHT hand on FAR RIGHT of trophy stem near x805,y625. Right arm is hidden BEHIND trophy, proximal root behind outer right hardcover edge. No third glove, no long blue arc across front pages. Keep all else, including trophy and ruby frame.

Rebuild ONLY book and arms to remove wrong socket on back panel. TRUE OPEN BOOK facing LEFT in clear three-quarter view: two cream INNER page planes with eyes, central gutter, rear indigo hardcover visible at edges, NO face on paper thickness. LEFT arm holds bow grip at LEFT outside body, RIGHT arm draws string with hand to RIGHT outside body. Each thin indigo arm starts BEHIND corresponding OUTERMOST cover side contour, root completely occluded. No rounded end painted on broad cover or page. Preserve archery target/garden, arrow, cap/mint bookmark and complete silver frame.

Reconstruct book and two arms as wide OPEN book at oblique angle facing right, both cream inner page planes and gutter, proud grin. LEFT hand holds large key at LEFT OUTSIDE body silhouette, thin LEFT arm comes from BEHIND OUTERMOST LEFT cover edge. RIGHT hand braces safe door to RIGHT OUTSIDE body, thin RIGHT arm from BEHIND OUTERMOST RIGHT cover edge. Both roots hidden by cover contours; delete blue rounded root on cream page entirely. Shift key/lock slightly left if needed so near hand stays OUTSIDE book silhouette. Preserve golden safe full of red-cross cards and gold frame.
